props.title: Fake-Siri
props.subtitle: Pilot speech moves to the gateway/GUI boundary — typed FMM initiation requests, never VM parsing
props.meta: 3 interview rounds · codex review · eval harness · JP act-as-FMM ruling · ~3% residual ambiguity

props.content: GOAL: the VM never processes pilot speech, and the demo never round-trips an FMM decision — we ARE the fake FMM. The flow: pilot (joystick button or PTT voice) → gateway transcribe → parse all the rules at the gateway boundary → emit the existing FMM-initiated transmission request → the VM speaks the ownship pilot call on the radio. Zero new ICD types; the seam the real Phase-3 app inherits (ATCTransmissionRequest into the VM) already exists. Scripted pilot rows leave VM scoring and become the fake-siri test corpus.

props.label: SECTIONS 1 · 2 · 4 · 5
props.title: Contracts & placement
props.subtitle: Every item scored; scores are residual ambiguity

props.title: §1 Goal & scope [2-3%]
props.content: Demo stand-in for the future NEW APP seat. Formalizes the shipping Tk PilotIntentMatcher path (pilot_actions.json + pilot_voice_aliases.json), radio subset only. **Executable route ledger**: all 63 console actions get `route: initiation | operator_trigger` — a test asserts sim/checklist triggers (engine_start) can never reach /initiation. Web pilot_console untouched (non-authority).

props.title: §2 Contracts [2-4%] — ZERO new ICD types
props.content: The wire into the VM is the **existing** `ATCTransmissionRequest(transmission=ATCTransmission(template_id, variables))` — fake-siri authors it directly, acting as the FMM. FMMInitiationRequest/FMMInitiationDecision are **deleted** (v4 artifacts of a decision hop JP ruled out). Console↔gateway = gateway-owned /copi/v1 shapes; the sync response {row_id, digest, dispatched | diagnostic} drives console UX — never the transmission lane's queued-only {status: accepted}. The only 'no' is `unmatched_pilot_utterance`.

props.title: §4 Placement & authority [2-3%]
props.content: Fake-siri is **gateway-side** (JP flow: gateway transcribes, parses all the rules — supersedes the round-3 console-side seat; PilotIntentMatcher's local matching retires in cleanup). Console = thin input device: button id or PTT audio. Authority line unchanged: SELECT a pre-authored row + FILL slots — never synthesize, never free NLU; unmatched fails closed. The Windows import handshake (review F9) is moot — loader, matcher, and gateway share one process.

props.title: §5 Acting as the FMM [2-4%]
props.content: No /initiation endpoint, no matcher in the fake FMM daemon — it is **untouched**. Fake-siri POSTs the authored request to fmm_client_daemon /transmission-request → NATS → response daemon → radio speech (the proven FMM-initiated lane; the VM's output voice IS ownship). Pilot-call templates are data rows beside existing response templates. Lane failure → typed `speech_dispatch_failed`, matched-but-unspoken is never silent.

One YAML bundle `data/atc/policy/pilot/fake_siri_phrasebook.yaml` behind a typed authority singleton (FlightStateTransitionAuthority precedent). Entry: {id, phrases[] | button_preset_id, phase_scope[], initiation_kind, slots, source, grounding_ref, route}. `initiation_kind` + slot-roles live in the bundle header (the transmission_origin precedent) — plain strings on the wire, policy-owned value set, no Python enum copy. Whole-bundle compiled_sha256 registered in the schema-load digest test (two files become three). [3-4%]

rows.brings: Nothing new — delegates to the same RegexParser

props.label: SECTION 6
props.title: VM shedding — how pilot speech leaves the voice module

props.content:
**The one buildable gate artifact (redefined pi-5):** thread `transmission_origin` into `run_callsign_stage` (today origin is consulted only post-parse) and add a typed `ownship_pilot` disposition to `observation_reasons`. Discriminant = origin × address_scope at the addressing gate: pilot × ownship → **pre-parse drop** with typed diagnostic. [4%]

Other-aircraft pilot speech: unchanged — no new party-line scorer (pre_fmm_observation is broadcast-only; pi-6 deleted). [3%]

**P7 carve-out intentionally dropped**: the reporting_obligation promotion + pilot_origin_authoritative_kinds allowlist + the fake-FMM consumer `_pilot_origin_metadata_fallback_allowed` (review F7) all retire after pi-5 lands — semantics relocate to fake-siri as initiation kind=report. Zero A2 pass-rate impact: all affected rows are already unscored. [3%]

The 70 rules: the speaker-axis plan owns them, **zero deletions** — shedding = reachability via the gate; regex bodies migrate to the phrasebook as content copies. Invariant: rule-count ledger. [3%]

Buttons: radio preset → console-side select+fill → typed request → /initiation; the **sync decision body drives console UX**. Sim triggers keep /copi/v1/mission/event untouched. Voice: PTT → existing gateway /copi/v1/transcribe → transcript matched console-side. Context ownership: the console (operator seat) owns flight-plan/phase/telemetry and supplies slot values — fake-siri never invents flight context; only the typed request crosses. [3%]

**Measured facts:** 97/218 A2 turns are pilot-speaker and ZERO are scored (scored_turn requires speaker==atc) — repartition is an inventory change; A2 pass-rate is invariant; a removed-rows table is mandatory. [3%]

**Gold provenance (non-circular):** row_id from a deterministic expected_intent→row index (not the runtime matcher); the 46 existing expected_parameters reused verbatim; expected EMISSION (template_id + variables) derived from the gold row + slots — the v4 decision column is deleted with the decision hop. Coverage gaps are flagged, never silently passed. [4%]

**Floor = 100%** — deterministic select+fill gets no soft floor; separate harness, never inside the 1546. Advisory-first, then CI-blocking (JP assumption #4). [4%]

**Signal-neutrality gate (NB6):** for each of the 46 parameter-bearing turns, select+fill must yield a slot SUPERSET of today's expected_parameters — any row the phrasebook cannot reproduce fails loudly. [4%]

props.label: SECTION 14
props.title: Eval harness — LFD contract & adversarial matrix
props.subtitle: Pentagon frame: every future worker is a tireless optimizer; the harness makes genuine capability cheaper than cheating. Tables: adversarial matrix, then the 10 fenced cheap paths.

props.content: **Target (all mechanical):** corpus row accuracy (row_id + slots + decision per gold, floor 100%) AND zero movement on all 1546 scored rows AND 46/46 explicit superset-parity outcomes. Failure directions: precision (wrong row, wrong slots, greedy regex) AND recall (missing presets, hidden coverage gaps). **Capacity caps:** phrasebook rows ≤ migrated rules + Tk presets, every row carries provenance — a row justified only by making one fixture pass is a cheat exhibit. **Gold before matcher:** the gold-authoring commit must precede the first harness run (receipt). **Probe:** paraphrase + ASR-noise perturbations must fail closed as unmatched — a silent wrong-row match means the matcher is too greedy. **Holdout:** live Tk console smoke over real HTTP, aggregate pass/fail only. **Named inventory gate:** attempted/matched/scored counts reported separately from just-baseline pass rate. [4%]

props.content: **Reversible additive tier (lands flag-OFF everywhere, zero behavior change):** the two ICD types, phrasebook loader/YAML + digest registration + route ledger, POST /initiation + _match_initiation_rule. The **console switch is its own gated demo-lane step** — that is where local/thor flip on (review F5 killed the on-by-default landing). **One-way tier (gated on pi-5):** pre-parse ingress drop, P7 retirement, A2 repartition + harness cutover with superset parity green. Per-step gates: self-parity, baseline non-regression, infra panel, schema-load, bucket 7, and the named inventory gate. A2 scored pass-rate invariant across every step. [3-4%]

props.title: §11 Observability [3%]
props.content: Typed diagnostics declared in the phrasebook bundle (peer of observation_reasons) — the gateway's ad-hoc error strings are rejected. Provenance {row_id, digest} rides the request; the unmatched case logs {row_id: null, digest, code} console/gateway-side.

props.title: §12 Failure modes [2-3%]
props.content: Two survivors, both fail-closed: `fmm_unreachable` and `unmatched_pilot_utterance`. Three round-2 guards DELETED with cause: stale-context (no Phase-2 server-side truth), idempotency store (the dedup precedent was false; console debounces), per-flight lock (subsumed by sync decide-then-respond + ordered speech lane).

NEW APP inherits three frozen seams: (1) FMMInitiationRequest + FMMInitiationDecision + sync /initiation semantics; (2) the ATCTransmissionRequest→VM speech lane via fmm_client_daemon — untouched by the swap; (3) the policy-owned initiation vocabulary. Deletable with fake-siri: phrasebook rows, Tk presets, regex bodies, fake-FMM manifest rules. NEW APP may add real NLU iff it resolves to the same vocabulary. [3%]

props.label: THE INTERVIEW
props.title: All 26 questions
props.subtitle: Non-leading, repo-verified before asking; answered decisively with file:line grounding

props.title: Round 1 — 10 questions (contracts & lanes)
props.content:
**Q1** What distinguishes a pilot-origin FMM initiation from the existing CommandProposal (Voice→FMM) and ATCTransmissionRequest (FMM→Voice) lanes on the wire?

**Q2** What set of responses must the fake FMM be able to return to a pilot initiation, and what does each mean for the pilot and for VM speech?

**Q3** When the fake FMM accepts a pilot initiation, by what mechanism does that reach the VM to produce spoken output?

**Q4** Into what single schema do the three existing pilot-phrase sources merge, and how are disagreements reconciled?

**Q5** Where does the authority line fall between fake-siri 'translating' pilot input and 'creating intent', given the gateway boundary forbids independent intent authority?

**Q6** After shedding, what does the VM do with an ownship pilot transmission vs an ambient/other-aircraft (party-line) pilot transmission?

**Q7** What is the ordering and ownership between this design's 70-rule shedding and the speaker-axis plan that tags-and-keeps the same rules under 'no rule deletions'?

**Q8** What crosses the console↔fake-siri boundary on a button press and a voice utterance, and who owns the flight-plan/phase context that fills slots?

**Q9** What defines pass vs fail for repurposed pilot rows, and what happens to A1/A2/B1/B2 numbers when those rows leave VM scoring?

**Q10** What parts of the fake-siri contract must stay stable so the Phase-3 NEW APP replaces fake-siri without changes reaching FMM or VM?

props.title: Round 2 — 10 questions (thin sections & contradictions)
props.content:
**Q1** What advances migration between steps (per-step gates), which are reversible vs one-way, and where do A2 numbers change?

**Q2** Which configuration layer owns the enable flag, and what does it default to per environment?

**Q3** Through which diagnostic surface do fake-siri diagnostics emit, and where is {row_id, digest} provenance stored?

**Q4** For FMM-unreachable, duplicate submit, stale context, concurrent requests — blanket fail-closed or distinct dispositions?

**Q5** Does the initiation_kind + slot-role vocabulary live in icd.py or as authority-loaded YAML?

**Q6** On FMM reject, is VM speech ever emitted (safety-critical), or is rejection purely pilot-app surface?

**Q7** What authors the accept/reject decision for the new type, and does that logic run in-process for scoring while the live console drives HTTP?

**Q8** How is the fake-siri corpus stood up and scored — carrier format, floor, CI-blocking vs advisory? (scored_turn already excludes every pilot row — reconcile.)

**Q9** The ownship-pilot drop moves pre-parse but the P7 carve-out depends on a post-parse discriminant — preserved how, or intentionally dropped?

**Q10** Whole-bundle digest or per-entry, and does the bundle get registered in the hardcoded schema-load test?

props.title: Round 3 — 6 blockers (exhaustion sweep)
props.content:
**Q1** How is gold {row_id, expected_slots, expected decision} established without per-turn hand-authoring or running the matcher-under-test to make its own gold?

**Q2** Which console is fake-siri replacing, and does it subsume the local PilotIntentMatcher/pilot_actions.json path? (The active Tk console resolves voice locally and never touches the gateway intent surface.)

**Q3** What is the synchronous response contract of POST /initiation, and how does a reject reason reach the pilot-app?

**Q4** What is 'stale' measured against, where does idempotency/serialization state live, and does the stale branch go unexercised by the in-process scorer?

**Q5** What emits and consumes pre_fmm_observation, what signal separates ownship-pilot (drop) from other-aircraft (observe), and where is the pi-5/pi-6 contract specified?

**Q6** What happens to the comprehension signal the 97 unscored pilot turns exercise today, and what acceptance test proves the migration is signal-neutral?

props.label: EXECUTION
props.title: Sequencing — first vertical slice & the migrate/cleanup order

props.content:
**Slice 0 (tracer bullet): radio check.** One slot-free radio call end-to-end behind the flag: joystick button AND the PTT phrase ('radio check') → gateway transcribe → seed phrasebook (3-5 rows) → ATCTransmissionRequest → fmm_client_daemon → VM speaks in the sim. Plus request_taxi as the first slotted call. Touches every seam — console input, gateway matcher, bundle loader + digest, speech lane, flag gating — while touching ZERO VM code. Gates: §14.5 preflight calibration first, then self-parity + zero movement on the 1546 + the guard test that no sim action reaches the fake-siri route.

**Then the order is: slice-first → migrate-parallel → cleanup-last.** Bulk phrasebook migration (63-action route ledger, the ~70 VM rules as content copies, corpus repurpose harness) is additive data work — it runs parallel to slice hardening and more slices (voice variants, slotted calls). All one-way cleanup (VM ingress drop, P7 + fake-FMM allowlist retirement, PilotIntentMatcher retirement, contract-families rebuild, A2 repartition) comes strictly LAST, gated on the slice + corpus proving the replacement lane. Cleanup-first was rejected: it deletes the only working pilot path before its replacement exists — demo risk with zero coverage.

props.title: 4 JP-review assumptions (defaults set — flip any, bounded blast radius)
props.content: 1) Prod flag default [off]. 2) Fake-siri corpus gate CI-blocking timing [advisory-first]. (v5 dissolved the other two: no ICD growth needed, no reject concept.)
